How Data Is Stored

There are two separate questions hidden inside “storage type”:

What physical medium holds the bits? RAM, SSD, tape, optical disc, DNA, etc.

How are those bits logically organized? Files, rows, columns, objects, graphs, logs, vectors, chunks, models, archives, etc.

A Parquet file, for example, could physically live on an SSD, tape cartridge, or cloud object store. Its logical representation and physical medium are different layers.

The complete practical map is therefore:

$$
\text{Information}
\rightarrow
\text{representation}
\rightarrow
\text{encoding}
\rightarrow
\text{container}
\rightarrow
\text{storage system}
\rightarrow
\text{physical medium}
$$
